title: أقدّر
form: I appreciate + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: I appreciate your honest feedback.
cells.ar: أقدّر ملاحظاتك الصادقة.
cells.description: Worker receiving thoughtful feedback

cells.en: I appreciate your patience today.
cells.ar: أقدّر صبرك اليوم.
cells.description: Adult thanking a patient clerk

cells.en: I appreciate you taking the time to explain.
cells.ar: أقدّر تخصيصك وقتًا للشرح.
cells.description: Tutor taking time to explain

cells.en: I appreciate everything you did.
cells.ar: أقدّر كل ما فعلته.
cells.description: Friend acknowledging generous help

cells.en: I appreciate your clear explanation.
cells.ar: أقدّر شرحك الواضح.
cells.description: Learner thanking an instructor beside a practical demonstration

cells.en: I appreciate you staying to help us.
cells.ar: أقدّر بقاءك لمساعدتنا.
cells.description: Team members cleaning a room after an event

cells.en: I appreciate the care you took with my order.
cells.ar: أقدّر العناية التي بذلتها في طلبي.
cells.description: Customer receiving carefully wrapped handmade goods

cells.en: I appreciate being included in the discussion.
cells.ar: أقدّر إتاحة المشاركة لي في النقاش.
cells.description: New colleague joining a meeting circle

cells.en: I appreciate your willingness to listen.
cells.ar: أقدّر استعدادك للإصغاء.
cells.description: Two adults having a thoughtful conversation

cells.en: I appreciate you telling me the truth.
cells.ar: أقدّر إخباري بالحقيقة.
cells.description: Friends speaking honestly across a cafe table

cells.en: I appreciate all the effort behind this event.
cells.ar: أقدّر كل الجهد المبذول في هذه الفعالية.
cells.description: Organizer thanking volunteers in an event hall

cells.en: I appreciate having a quiet place to study.
cells.ar: أقدّر وجود مكان هادئ أدرس فيه.
cells.description: Adult learner studying peacefully in a library

cells.en: You're welcome. I'm happy to help.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. يسعدني المساعدة.
cells.description: Helper responding warmly to thanks

cells.en: You're welcome. It was no trouble.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. لم يكن هناك أي إزعاج.
cells.description: Neighbor reassuring someone after a small favor

cells.en: You're welcome. See you tomorrow.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. أراك غدًا.
cells.description: Friends parting after an act of help

cells.en: You're welcome. Let me know if you need more.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. أخبرني إذا احتجت المزيد.
cells.description: Tutor offering further assistance

cells.en: You're welcome. Enjoy your meal.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. استمتع بوجبتك.
cells.description: Server responding warmly to a diner

cells.en: You're welcome. I'm glad you found it useful.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. يسعدني أنك وجدته مفيدًا.
cells.description: Tutor responding after sharing a useful guide

cells.en: You're welcome. Your bag wasn't heavy.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. لم تكن حقيبتك ثقيلة.
cells.description: Adult returning a bag after carrying it upstairs

cells.en: You're welcome. I enjoyed showing you around.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. استمتعت باصطحابك في جولة.
cells.description: Resident and visitor at the end of a town walk

cells.en: You're welcome. We make a good team.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. نحن نشكل فريقًا جيدًا.
cells.description: Colleagues finishing a shared task

cells.en: You're welcome. You can return the book next week.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. يمكنك إعادة الكتاب الأسبوع المقبل.
cells.description: Friend lending a book to another adult

cells.en: You're welcome. Have a safe journey.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. أتمنى لك رحلة آمنة.
cells.description: Station employee responding to a grateful traveler

cells.en: You're welcome. I'm glad I could help today.
cells.ar: على الرحب والسعة. يسعدني أنني استطعت المساعدة اليوم.
cells.description: Neighbor smiling after fixing a garden gate

title: أنا آسف على
form: I'm sorry for + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: I'm sorry for being late today.
cells.ar: أنا آسف على التأخر اليوم.
cells.description: Adult apologizing for arriving late

cells.en: I'm sorry for the confusion.
cells.ar: أنا آسف على الالتباس.
cells.description: Colleagues clearing up a misunderstanding

cells.en: I'm sorry for interrupting you.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لمقاطعتك.
cells.description: Adult apologizing after interrupting

cells.en: I'm sorry for losing your pen.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لإضاعة قلمك.
cells.description: Learner explaining a lost borrowed pen

cells.en: I'm sorry for breaking your cup.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لكسر كوبك.
cells.description: Adult apologizing beside a broken cup

cells.en: I'm sorry for speaking too quickly.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لتحدثي بسرعة زائدة.
cells.description: Speaker slowing down for a learner

cells.en: I'm sorry for forgetting our appointment.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لنسيان موعدنا.
cells.description: Adult checking a calendar while apologizing by phone

cells.en: I'm sorry for the noise last night.
cells.ar: أنا آسف على الضوضاء الليلة الماضية.
cells.description: Neighbor speaking apologetically at a doorway

cells.en: I'm sorry for giving you the wrong directions.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لإعطائك إرشادات خاطئة للطريق.
cells.description: Resident correcting a route on a map

cells.en: I'm sorry for leaving the kitchen untidy.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لترك المطبخ غير مرتب.
cells.description: Adult beginning to clean an untidy kitchen

cells.en: I'm sorry for missing your call.
cells.ar: أنا آسف لعدم الرد على مكالمتك.
cells.description: Adult returning a missed phone call

cells.en: I'm sorry for the extra work I caused.
cells.ar: أنا آسف على العمل الإضافي الذي تسببت فيه.
cells.description: Colleague offering to help correct a paperwork mistake

title: لا بأس
form: That's all right + optional reassuring sentence

cells.en: That's all right. We can try again.
cells.ar: لا بأس. يمكننا المحاولة مجددًا.
cells.description: Teacher reassuring a learner after a mistake

cells.en: That's all right. Please take your time.
cells.ar: لا بأس. خذ وقتك من فضلك.
cells.description: Adult patiently waiting at a table

cells.en: That's all right. I understand.
cells.ar: لا بأس. أتفهم الأمر.
cells.description: Friend accepting an apology

cells.en: That's all right. Everyone makes mistakes.
cells.ar: لا بأس. الجميع يرتكب أخطاء.
cells.description: Colleague reassuring another after an error

cells.en: That's all right. The cup was old anyway.
cells.ar: لا بأس. كان الكوب قديمًا على أي حال.
cells.description: Adult reassuring a friend beside a broken cup

cells.en: That's all right. We can move the meeting.
cells.ar: لا بأس. يمكننا تغيير موعد الاجتماع.
cells.description: Colleagues calmly checking a calendar

cells.en: That's all right. I have another pen.
cells.ar: لا بأس. لدي قلم آخر.
cells.description: Learner offering a spare pen after an apology

cells.en: That's all right. You didn't wake me.
cells.ar: لا بأس. لم توقظني.
cells.description: Adult calmly responding to an apologetic caller

cells.en: That's all right. Let's fix it together.
cells.ar: لا بأس. لنصلحه معًا.
cells.description: Friends looking at a small repair task

cells.en: That's all right. I can wait a few minutes.
cells.ar: لا بأس. يمكنني الانتظار بضع دقائق.
cells.description: Customer responding patiently at a service desk

cells.en: That's all right. Nothing was damaged.
cells.ar: لا بأس. لم يتضرر شيء.
cells.description: Adults checking a tipped but unbroken plant pot

cells.en: That's all right. Please don't worry about it.
cells.ar: لا بأس. لا تقلق بشأن الأمر من فضلك.
cells.description: Friend warmly accepting an apology

title: هل يمكنك التوضيح
form: Could you clarify + noun or what you mean

cells.en: Could you clarify the last point?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح النقطة الأخيرة؟
cells.description: Colleague requesting a clearer meeting point

cells.en: Could you clarify what you mean?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح ما تقصده؟
cells.description: Learner asking what a speaker means

cells.en: Could you clarify the instructions, please?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح التعليمات من فضلك؟
cells.description: Instructor clarifying written instructions

cells.en: Could you clarify which room we need?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح أي غرفة نحتاجها؟
cells.description: Visitor asking which room to enter

cells.en: Could you clarify when the payment is due?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح موعد استحقاق الدفع؟
cells.description: Customer discussing a bill with a clerk

cells.en: Could you clarify how the groups will be formed?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح كيفية تشكيل المجموعات؟
cells.description: Adult learners listening to an instructor

cells.en: Could you clarify the difference between these two options?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح الفرق بين هذين الخيارين؟
cells.description: Customer comparing two service brochures

cells.en: Could you clarify who is responsible for the keys?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح من المسؤول عن المفاتيح؟
cells.description: Team members discussing a set of keys

cells.en: Could you clarify whether we need to book in advance?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح ما إذا كنا نحتاج إلى الحجز مسبقًا؟
cells.description: Visitor speaking to a museum receptionist

cells.en: Could you clarify the meaning of this word?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح معنى هذه الكلمة؟
cells.description: Learner indicating a word in a book

cells.en: Could you clarify why the meeting was postponed?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح سبب تأجيل الاجتماع؟
cells.description: Colleagues reviewing an updated meeting calendar

cells.en: Could you clarify which documents I should bring?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح المستندات التي ينبغي أن أحضرها؟
cells.description: Applicant checking a folder with a clerk

cells.en: Let me know if you need help.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا احتجت مساعدة.
cells.description: Tutor offering further help

cells.en: Let me know if the time changes.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا تغير الموعد.
cells.description: Colleagues discussing a possible time change

cells.en: Let me know if you have a question.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا كان لديك سؤال.
cells.description: Learner being invited to ask questions

cells.en: Let me know if you arrive early.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا وصلت مبكرًا.
cells.description: Host asking for notice of early arrival

cells.en: Let me know if you can't find the entrance.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا لم تستطع العثور على المدخل.
cells.description: Host giving directions to an arriving visitor

cells.en: Let me know if the room feels too cold.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا شعرت بأن الغرفة باردة جدًا.
cells.description: Host indicating a room thermostat

cells.en: Let me know if your flight is delayed.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا تأخرت رحلتك الجوية.
cells.description: Traveler discussing airport pickup by phone

cells.en: Let me know if you'd prefer a different date.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا كنت تفضل موعدًا آخر.
cells.description: Colleagues considering alternative dates on a calendar

cells.en: Let me know if the instructions are unclear.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا كانت التعليمات غير واضحة.
cells.description: Teacher offering clarification during a practical lesson

cells.en: Let me know if you hear from the repair shop.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا وصلتك أخبار من محل الإصلاح.
cells.description: Friends discussing a bicycle awaiting repair

cells.en: Let me know if there is any food you can't eat.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا كان هناك طعام لا يمكنك تناوله.
cells.description: Host planning a meal with a guest

cells.en: Let me know if you change your mind about joining us.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا غيرت رأيك بشأن الانضمام إلينا.
cells.description: Friends leaving an open invitation at a cafe

cells.en: I stayed inside because it was raining.
cells.ar: بقيت في الداخل لأن المطر كان يهطل.
cells.description: Adult watching rain indoors

cells.en: I practice English because I want to travel.
cells.ar: أتدرب على الإنجليزية لأنني أريد السفر.
cells.description: Learner studying beside travel plans

cells.en: She smiled because she heard good news.
cells.ar: ابتسمت لأنها سمعت خبرًا سارًا.
cells.description: Woman smiling after receiving news

cells.en: We left early because the road was busy.
cells.ar: غادرنا مبكرًا لأن الطريق كان مزدحمًا.
cells.description: Travelers leaving before heavy traffic

cells.en: I brought an umbrella because the sky looked dark.
cells.ar: أحضرت مظلة لأن السماء بدت داكنة.
cells.description: Adult packing an umbrella beneath dark clouds

cells.en: We chose this cafe because it has a quiet garden.
cells.ar: اخترنا هذا المقهى لأن له حديقة هادئة.
cells.description: Friends seated in a peaceful cafe garden

cells.en: She took a break because her eyes were tired.
cells.ar: أخذت استراحة لأن عينيها كانتا متعبتين.
cells.description: Woman resting her eyes beside a laptop

cells.en: I called you because I needed your advice.
cells.ar: اتصلت بك لأنني احتجت إلى نصيحتك.
cells.description: Adult seeking advice during a phone call

cells.en: The children whispered because the baby was asleep.
cells.ar: همس الأطفال لأن الرضيع كان نائمًا.
cells.description: Family speaking quietly beside a sleeping baby

cells.en: He walked to work because his bicycle was broken.
cells.ar: مشى إلى العمل لأن دراجته كانت معطلة.
cells.description: Worker walking past a bicycle awaiting repair

cells.en: We moved the plants because they needed more light.
cells.ar: نقلنا النباتات لأنها احتاجت إلى مزيد من الضوء.
cells.description: Adults moving plant pots toward a window

cells.en: I read the instructions twice because I wanted to be sure.
cells.ar: قرأت التعليمات مرتين لأنني أردت التأكد.
cells.description: Adult carefully reviewing assembly instructions

title: بسبب
form: main clause + because of + noun or gerund

cells.en: The game stopped because of the rain.
cells.ar: توقفت اللعبة بسبب المطر.
cells.description: Players leaving a wet sports field

cells.en: The bus was late because of traffic.
cells.ar: تأخرت الحافلة بسبب الازدحام.
cells.description: Bus waiting in heavy traffic

cells.en: The plants grew well because of the sunlight.
cells.ar: نمت النباتات جيدًا بسبب ضوء الشمس.
cells.description: Plants beside a sunny window

cells.en: I was tired because of working late.
cells.ar: كنت متعبًا بسبب العمل حتى وقت متأخر.
cells.description: Tired adult resting after working late

cells.en: The road was closed because of a fallen tree.
cells.ar: أُغلق الطريق بسبب شجرة ساقطة.
cells.description: Travelers stopped beside a fallen tree

cells.en: I couldn't sleep because of the noise outside.
cells.ar: لم أستطع النوم بسبب الضوضاء في الخارج.
cells.description: Adult awake beside a busy street

cells.en: The event moved indoors because of the strong wind.
cells.ar: نُقلت الفعالية إلى الداخل بسبب الرياح القوية.
cells.description: Volunteers moving chairs indoors in windy weather

cells.en: She found the station because of your clear directions.
cells.ar: عثرت على المحطة بفضل إرشاداتك الواضحة.
cells.description: Traveler checking directions beside a station

cells.en: We arrived late because of a flat tire.
cells.ar: وصلنا متأخرين بسبب إطار مثقوب.
cells.description: Adults beside a car with a flat tire

cells.en: He felt tired because of working two shifts.
cells.ar: شعر بالتعب بسبب عمله ورديتين.
cells.description: Exhausted worker sitting in a staff room

cells.en: The room smelled fresh because of the flowers.
cells.ar: فاحت في الغرفة رائحة عطرة بسبب الزهور.
cells.description: Adult enjoying fresh flowers in a room

cells.en: I missed the announcement because of wearing headphones.
cells.ar: فاتني الإعلان بسبب ارتدائي سماعات الرأس.
cells.description: Traveler removing headphones beside a station attendant

cells.en: It was cold, so I wore a jacket.
cells.ar: كان الجو باردًا، لذا ارتديت سترة.
cells.description: Adult wearing a jacket in cold weather

cells.en: She studied hard, so she passed the test.
cells.ar: درست بجد، لذلك نجحت في الاختبار.
cells.description: Learner receiving a successful test result

cells.en: We were hungry, so we made lunch.
cells.ar: كنا جائعين، لذا أعددنا الغداء.
cells.description: Friends preparing lunch when hungry

cells.en: The shop was closed, so we went home.
cells.ar: كان المتجر مغلقًا، لذلك عدنا إلى المنزل.
cells.description: Shoppers outside a closed shop

cells.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
cells.ar: كانت الحافلة ممتلئة، لذا انتظرنا التالية.
cells.description: Travelers waiting as a crowded bus departs

cells.en: I couldn't reach the shelf, so I asked for help.
cells.ar: لم أستطع الوصول إلى الرف، لذا طلبت المساعدة.
cells.description: Adult seeking help beside a high shelf

cells.en: She lost her key, so she called the landlord.
cells.ar: فقدت مفتاحها، لذا اتصلت بمالك المنزل.
cells.description: Woman calling beside a locked apartment

cells.en: We had extra vegetables, so we made soup.
cells.ar: كانت لدينا خضروات زائدة، لذا أعددنا حساءً.
cells.description: Family cooking soup with vegetables

cells.en: The room was too dark, so I opened the curtains.
cells.ar: كانت الغرفة مظلمة جدًا، لذا فتحت الستائر.
cells.description: Adult opening curtains in a dark room

cells.en: He wanted to improve his pronunciation, so he recorded himself.
cells.ar: أراد تحسين نطقه، لذا سجل صوته.
cells.description: Learner recording speech with a phone

cells.en: The path was slippery, so we walked slowly.
cells.ar: كان الممر زلقًا، لذا مشينا ببطء.
cells.description: Walkers carefully crossing a wet path

cells.en: Our team finished early, so we helped the others.
cells.ar: أنهى فريقنا العمل مبكرًا، لذا ساعدنا الآخرين.
cells.description: Volunteers joining another team's task

title: لهذا السبب
form: reason sentence. That's why + result clause

cells.en: I missed the bus. That's why I'm late.
cells.ar: فاتتني الحافلة. لهذا السبب تأخرت.
cells.description: Late learner arriving after missing a bus

cells.en: A fallen tree blocked the road. That's why we turned back.
cells.ar: سدت شجرة ساقطة الطريق. لهذا السبب عدنا.
cells.description: Travelers turning back before a fallen tree

cells.en: She trained daily. That's why she improved.
cells.ar: تدربت يوميًا. ولهذا تحسنت.
cells.description: Athlete improving with practice

cells.en: The room was noisy. That's why I moved.
cells.ar: كانت الغرفة صاخبة. ولهذا انتقلت.
cells.description: Adult leaving a noisy room

cells.en: My phone battery died. That's why I didn't reply.
cells.ar: نفدت بطارية هاتفي. لهذا السبب لم أرد.
cells.description: Adult showing a phone with an empty battery

cells.en: The library is quiet. That's why I study there.
cells.ar: المكتبة هادئة. لهذا السبب أدرس هناك.
cells.description: Learner reading peacefully in a library

cells.en: She knows the route well. That's why she's leading the walk.
cells.ar: تعرف الطريق جيدًا. لهذا السبب تقود المجموعة في المشي.
cells.description: Woman guiding walkers along a trail

cells.en: I washed the floor. That's why it's still wet.
cells.ar: غسلت الأرضية. لهذا السبب ما زالت مبتلة.
cells.description: Adult holding a mop beside a wet floor

cells.en: The train leaves soon. That's why we're hurrying.
cells.ar: يغادر القطار قريبًا. لهذا السبب نحن مستعجلون.
cells.description: Travelers hurrying toward a platform

cells.en: He forgot his glasses. That's why he can't read the menu.
cells.ar: نسي نظارته. لهذا السبب لا يستطيع قراءة قائمة الطعام.
cells.description: Diner struggling to read a menu

cells.en: We saved a little every week. That's why we can afford the trip.
cells.ar: ادخرنا قليلًا كل أسبوع. لهذا السبب نستطيع تحمل تكلفة الرحلة.
cells.description: Couple reviewing savings and travel plans Use respectful conversational distance and neutral gestures, no romantic staging or physical intimacy.

cells.en: I misunderstood the date. That's why I came a day early.
cells.ar: فهمت التاريخ خطأ. لهذا السبب جئت قبل الموعد بيوم.
cells.description: Visitor checking an appointment at reception
